bullets: Weekend ES plan: 6897 is the big support. A 7125 reclaim sees 7223, then a 7309 backtest — sell there. 6770 below. For the Sunday open: reclaim 6960, then 7025.
Structure: the August–November megaphone broke at 7309 and ES lost its April 2025 trendline. Bears control below 7306–09; bulls need 7306–09, 7421 and 7519 back before anyone talks about a bottom.
Positioning: every board is negative gamma with no flip. SPX's biggest strike moved 7200 → 6500; SPY's 700 is now above price; VIX's wall moved 30 → 40.
Tape: net −$466M, put/call 1.72, led by SPY Nov 27 / Dec 4 put buying (675 Dec 4 $175M, 700 Nov 27 $91.2M, 680 Nov 27 $80.0M). SPY IV rank hit 100%; Fear & Greed 14.

Oversold: SPY hourly RSI 12, the lowest since February 2020; several reads look for a sharp counter-rally (one 2018 analog points to SPY 740s), others see a 2000/2008-style unwind. December rate hike still priced; a 50bp move is off the table.
